name: Magnesium
summary: Magnesium metal: anode rods in water heaters and fire-starting blocks.
uses: Shavings as an emergency fire starter (lit with a spark)
Sacrificial anode to protect tanks and boats from rust
identify: The anode rod in most tank water heaters: a long pale grey rod screwed into the top, often pitted. Camping shops sell magnesium blocks; some old wheels, engine castings and laptop frames are magnesium alloy. Some anode rods are aluminium or zinc instead.
test: Scrape a small pile of shavings and hit them with a spark or flame: magnesium flares bright white, aluminium won’t. Burning magnesium is extremely hot and water makes it worse: smother it with dry sand.
